score my loco model out of 10 and tell me what to fix
critique my claude design canvas for the HUD
review this web page mockup honestly
build me a signal box in blender

checks.run: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); python3 {skill}/scripts/critic_kit.py log $d --pass 1 --kind full --scores A1=6 --tokens 9 --agent a --est --mode self && python3 {skill}/scripts/critic_kit.py log $d --pass 2 --kind delta --scores A1=7 --tokens 20 --agent a --mode self; rm -rf $d'

python3 -c "import ast,sys; t=ast.parse(open('{skill}/scripts/blender_kit.py').read()); n={f.name for f in t.body if isinstance(f,ast.FunctionDef)}; sys.exit(0 if {'floating_parts','coplanar_overlaps'}<=n else 1)"
